item.title: Cardinals hire Rams OC Mike LaFleur as head coach
item.description: TEMPE, Ariz. (AP) — The Arizona Cardinals have hired Mike LaFleur as their new head coach with the Los Angeles Rams offensive coordinator agreeing to a five-year contract, the team announced Sunday. item.title: Sources: Raiders expected to hire Seahawks’ Kubiak as coach
item.description: LAS VEGAS (AP) — The Las Vegas Raiders are expected to hire Seattle Seahawks offensive coordinator Klint Kubiak as their next head coach after the Super Bowl, sources told ESPN’s Adam Schefter on Sunday. item.title: Rose sets scoring mark in wire-to-wire victory at Torrey Pines
item.description: SAN DIEGO (AP) — Justin Rose became the first wire-to-wire winner at Torrey Pines in 71 years, starting with a six-shot lead and never letting anyone get any closer to him Sunday as he closed with a 2-under 70 to win the Farmers Insurance Open. item.title: NASCAR’s Clash moved to Wednesday due to historic snowfall
item.description: WINSTON, SALEM, N.C. (AP) — A bomb cyclone over North Carolina forced NASCAR to push its preseason exhibition to Wednesday night because the snow-covered roads are too dangerous for teams and fans to get to historic Bowman-Gray Stadium.
